This document outlines the equipment inspection list I2, which 
 must be carried out on yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

This pump is used for transfer 
 raw water from pump house to closed cooling system to cool the closed cooling 
 equipments
Technical Specifications:

 revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Abouda El Bana.
